map.IBNR = 终极赔款 × (1−已付比例): Total unpaid = ultimate losses × (1 − paid ratio); pure IBNR = total unpaid − reported outstanding (not below 0)
map.输入终极赔款与已付比例，求 IBNR 准备金。: Enter ultimate losses and paid ratio to get total unpaid; enter reported outstanding to get pure IBNR.
map.由终极赔款乘未付比例估已发生未报案准备金。: Multiply ultimate losses by the unpaid ratio to get total unpaid claims.
map.做准备金充足性快速校验。: A quick check of reserve adequacy.
map.已付比例高说明什么？: What does a high paid ratio mean?
map.已付 70% 说明理赔较成熟，IBNR 仅剩 30%；早期业务已付低 IBNR: 70% paid means claims are mature and total unpaid is 30%; pure IBNR is smaller after subtracting reported outstanding.
map.用已付比例估 IBNR 会低估吗？: Does estimating IBNR from the paid ratio underestimate it?
map.会。已付比例高仅代表钱付得快，未报案案件（reporting lag）仍可能大量: Yes. A high paid ratio only means money was paid quickly; unreported claims may remain. Total unpaid is not pure IBNR—reported outstanding must be deducted.
